messages.author: e452970a8244a89b
messages.subject: Warning message when running gdistsamp
parts:
Hello message board,
  I have two different versions of R set up on a desktop (v.2.15.3) and a laptop (v.3.0.0).  I ran the following code on the desktop and the laptop: 

HN_WindObs_P<-gdistsamp(~1,~1,~WindKm+Obs,keyfun="halfnorm",mixture="P", unitsOut="ha", output="density",data=umf)

The model converged just fine and produced identical parameters on both computers.  But on the laptop, I also got the following warning messages:

Warning messages:
1: In log(cp[J+1]_:NaNs produced
2: In log(cp[J+1]_:NaNs produced
...
10: In log(cp[J+1]_:NaNs produced

This only occurs on a subset of models and oddly enough thus far it's only happened when the key function is defined as half-normal.
I am not sure what's going on, but I thought I'd post it in case other people are having similar issues.

Andrew

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Warning message when running gdistsamp
parts:
Not sure what is going on, but it is most likely related to different versions of unmarked. Which ones are you using? Do you get the same parameter estimates? The new version of unmarked computes the integral analytically (for some of the detection functions), whereas the old version used numerical integration via integrate(). 

Richard
